summary: Frontend testing of Connect Pro - Zelix changes: sidebar Campaign/Leads split, Employees form (emp_type + Blood Group, no office / no home-office row), and Team → Create User flow driven by employee picker with role auto-derivation. All primary behaviours verified against super_admin. QA data created was cleaned up.
verified_features: Sidebar order: nav-campaign before nav-leads; no 'CRM / Leads' label anywhere.
Campaign nav opens /campaign with data-testid=campaign-page and NO crm-tabs.
Leads nav opens /leads with data-testid=leads-page AND data-testid=crm-all-leads present; NO crm-tabs.
Employees Add dialog: cli-office removed; cli-home-office-row is display:none; cli-blood-group dropdown present.
Type dropdown (cli-type) shows exactly 'User (Employees)' and 'Admin' for super_admin.
Created QA Employee (User) with blood group O+ — card shows 'User (Employees)' badge and 'Blood O+' chip.
Created QA Admin employee (Admin type) with blood group A+ — card shows 'Admin' badge.
Create User dialog (create-user-dialog) role dropdown has ONLY 'User' and 'Admin' options.
Employee picker (cu-linked-client) lists QA Employee and QA Admin; picking QA Employee auto-fills cu-name to 'QA Employee' and role to User.
Picking QA Admin auto-switches role to 'Admin' (super_admin).
Submitting Create User with a valid email succeeded, dialog closed, and the user appeared in Approved tab with 'user' badge.

Regression: Overview page renders dashboard-page + crm-overview; Settings shows change-password-card and settings-customize-section; sidebar has Overview, Campaign, Leads, Employees, Messages, Team, Activity, Settings.
notes: Backend rejects emails with unresolvable TLDs (e.g. '@qa.test') with 422 due to pydantic EmailStr deliverability check — this is expected behaviour, not a bug. Used '@example.com' in retest to confirm the happy path works.

Sonner validation toast for 'Pick an employee to give login access' code path exists (CreateUserDialog.jsx line 66) and fires correctly on empty linked_client_id — the toast could not be captured via DOM innerText scraping in the automation due to the sonner li render timing, but manual inspection of the code confirms the behaviour is correct.
Team page 'delete-<user_id>' testid uses the pattern 'delete-<id>' (not 'delete-user-<id>'); noted for future test automation.
critical_code_review_comments: CreateUserIn (backend/routers/users.py) still allows roles 'office_admin' and 'staff' and takes an 'office' field, but the frontend Create User dialog now only exposes 'user' and 'super_admin'. The backend model can be tightened to Literal['user','super_admin'] to match the new UX (or the extras kept intentionally for internal use — worth confirming).
Team page delete button uses data-testid='delete-<id>' but semantically it's a user delete. Consider renaming to 'delete-user-<id>' for clarity/testability consistency with 'delete-cli-<id>'.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily created 2 employees (QA Employee, QA Admin) and 1 login user (qa.employee.<ts>@example.com). All 3 records were deleted after testing — final state screenshot confirmed only the seed Workspace Admin remains in Approved tab and no employees remain on the Employees page.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All three changes (sidebar split, employee-driven Create User with role derivation, employees form emp_type+blood_group replacing office/home-office) verified end-to-end via super_admin. Backend pydantic EmailStr will reject non-DNS TLDs — use '@example.com' or similar in future tests. Team page delete btn testid pattern is 'delete-<user_id>'.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs detected in this iteration.
